title: fix: a record item can name many tests
headline: A build record item can name many tests in a tests list, so a build with hundreds of new tests names each one without a changelog line per test.
alignment: v1.50.1 is a patch before build 24: one record field and the test check that reads it, each test seen failing first.

items.text: A build record item may carry a tests list of test keys; the record check refuses a list that holds anything but test keys.
items.where: A record item that names many tests
items.after: A tests list of test keys, each checked
items.test: tests/build-record.test.mjs::a record item names many tests as a list of test keys, and a tests value that is not such a list is refused

items.text: CI's test check counts every test an item names in its tests list as named, and still flags a new test no item names.
items.test: tests/test-check.test.mjs::the test check counts every test an item names in its tests list, and still flags a new test no item names
